name: Adipogenic progenitor
short_description: Mesenchymal-stem-cell-derived precursor that sits as a mural (pericyte-like) cell wrapped around small blood vessels in adipose tissue; still uncommitted, but usually differentiates into a fat cell. Compact, stellate body with several thin radiating processes, a large euchromatic nucleus, moderate rough ER/Golgi/mitochondria, and (once adipogenic signalling starts) a handful of small early lipid droplets.
